description: An issue asks for a second config/gate for a need an existing, citable mechanism already fully serves. Stage 01b must verdict delete-retire, cite the existing mechanism by file:line or name, post exactly one comment, apply wontfix, and stop the pipeline before stage 02 runs.

messages.text: Add a second env var, SKIP_NO_AUTOMATION_CHECK, so the pipeline can be told to ignore the no-automation label on a per-run basis.

turns.setup: Stage 01b reads the stage 01 handoff and searches the repo. `stages/00-automation-guard/CONTEXT.md` already gates on the `no-automation` label for every run, and no comment or code shows that gate is insufficient for this issue's stated need.

expectedBehavior.description: The stage 01b handoff records Verdict: delete-retire and cites `stages/00-automation-guard/CONTEXT.md` (the existing no-automation gate) as the mechanism already serving the need. It must not invent a distinct rationale for a second gate.

Stages 02-07 do not run. Exactly one comment is posted naming the verdict and the cited mechanism, the `wontfix` label is applied, and `status=success` is emitted. No PRD is drafted and the issue body is not rewritten.

failureShape.observedFailure: Before this stage existed, every issue went straight from read-issue to context-completeness with nothing challenging the ask itself, so a request for a second mechanism serving an already-met need would sail through to a full PRD and, eventually, a second gate/config/flag duplicating one that already worked.
failureShape.note: Must fail against the pre-#169 straight-to-PRD behavior and pass once a citable existing mechanism stops the pipeline at stage 01b with a named mechanism, never a guessed one.
